about: Every kind a Note can be (its type, e.kind), in the order the Studio's Kind menu lists them. One for each outing with a track (ride, hike) or without (forage), the Mini-Cast, and one for each magazine category (field/data/magazines.json), so a Note that isn't an outing, like a drone montage of decades of footage, needn't pretend to be a ride or a hike (Christian, Oct 13, 2026). name: what cards and kickers call it. tag: its category word (Play's filters, its address words, looks.json categories); an existing Note tag where one already says the same. magazine: the template that suits it (none for the forage walk and Mini-Cast). track: whether it's an outing with a GPS track (the Studio asks for one, and its stats show). Read by field/tools/publish.mjs, studio/api.php (config, and a Note's categories), studio/assets/studio.js and social.js.
